reviews.comment: Good at explaining linear algebra concepts, but honestly most of the learning comes from the book and hw. No quizzes but long weekly homework, but her exams are very fair and her study guides are good.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nice professor, clear lectures, helpful during office hours. Only grades were from homework and exams. Homeworks were due at 5 pm weekly, which could be annoying, but she potentially gave back points. Exams were not too difficult, but were a little tight on time. Gave 5 bonus points on the final by doing a review she posted.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The hardest part for me was the exam which was inadequately timed (50 mins, 5-7 questions that can range to part h), but I prioritized accuracy over speed AND I was in an honors section. Her tests are basically her reviews and homework with numbers changed, and she explained everything like we were middle schoolers: clear, concise, and no-nonsense.

Prof. Gong has won a gold medal in IMO and is a true expert in advanced math. Teaching courses such as abstract algebra is as easy for her as drinking water. Nevertheless, she devotes great attention to students, striving to clarify concepts. She patiently responds to every question in a highly detailed manner, regardless of how trivial it is.
She's chill. Decent amount of homework but the exams are similar to the homework and very possible to do well on

Definitely one of the better Linear Alegbra teachers - the others give alot of homework and make their tests stupid hard. Linear is boring, annoying, and confusing but Sherry does a good job at explaining concepts clearly and helps alot outside of class. Her tests are like the homeworks and reviews.

Professor Gong was a great professor who really cared about her students. She responded to her emails pretty quickly usually and her lectures were really helpful for homework. The exams were based off homework so as long as you practice, you'll do fine. The textbook is not mandatory to buy since she posts pdf scans for homework and reading herself!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Gong is truly one of the greatest professors on this campus and is just a perfect instructor for this course. She knows the subject like the back of her hand, but also knows how to teach it for the students to understand. She makes a subject like linear algebra becomes very easy. Classes are not mandatory, but I recommend going.
